results.label: scam
results.text: USPS: Your package could not be delivered due to an unpaid customs fee of $1.99. Pay within 12 hours or it will be returned: http://usps-redelivery-help.top/pay
results.summary: This is a fake USPS delivery-fee scam using a look-alike website to steal payment information — USPS never texts you to pay customs fees this way.

results.label: scam
results.text: FedEx: We attempted delivery but nobody was home. Confirm your address and reschedule here: fedex-reschedule-now.info/track?id=88213
results.summary: This text pretends to be FedEx and uses a fake address that is not FedEx's real website to get you to click and enter personal information.

results.label: scam
results.text: DHL Express: your parcel is held at our depot. A customs charge of $2.45 is required. Pay at dhl-customs-pay.xyz to release it.
results.summary: This is a fake DHL customs payment scam — the link is not DHL's real website and DHL would never collect customs fees this way.

results.label: scam
results.text: NJ E-ZPass: You have an unpaid toll balance of $12.50. To avoid a $50 late fee, pay by today: ezpass-nj-tollpay.top/inv
results.summary: This is a fake E-ZPass toll text trying to get you to pay on a non-official website — the link does not belong to E-ZPass and uses scare-tactics about a late fee.

results.label: scam
results.text: Chase Alert: Unusual $849.00 charge on your card. If this was not you, verify now or your account will be locked: chase-secure-verify.top/login
results.summary: This is a fake Chase text. It uses a look-alike .top domain that is not chase.com to try to steal your login with a scare about an $849 charge and a locked account.

results.label: scam
results.text: Wells Fargo: Your account has been temporarily restricted. Call our fraud department at 1-855-555-0113 immediately to restore access.
results.summary: This is a fake Wells Fargo alert trying to get you to call an unofficial number — do not call 1-855-555-0113.

results.label: scam
results.text: Bank of America: we detected a login from a new device. To cancel, reply with the 6-digit code we just sent you.
results.summary: This impersonates Bank of America and tries to steal your one-time login code — a bank will never ask you to reply with it.

results.label: scam
results.text: Zelle: A payment of $500 to you is pending because your account is not upgraded. Send $100 to unlock it, you will be refunded instantly.
results.summary: This is a fake Zelle message - Zelle never asks you to pay money to unlock a payment.

results.label: scam
results.text: Venmo: you were sent $350 by mistake. Please return it via this link right away or your account will be suspended: venmo-refund-help.click/r
results.summary: This is a fake Venmo message trying to steal your money — the link is not Venmo's real website and uses a suspension threat to pressure you to click.

results.label: scam
results.text: PayPal invoice #INV-44821 for $479.99 (Norton antivirus renewal) has been paid. If you did not authorize this, call 1-888-555-0177 within 24 hours to cancel.
results.summary: This is a fake PayPal/Norton invoice pressuring you to call a number to cancel a $479.99 charge — a classic callback scam to steal your information or money.
